attr.title: Verdant Crown
attr.desc: Overworld action-adventure for the RK3326 handheld: explore a verdant overworld, delve ruined temples with sword and dodge, beat the boss and reclaim the crown. A winnable 10-15 minute vertical slice - one hub, five dungeon rooms, one boss - in unshaded low-poly 3D with a top-down camera.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
